notes: Paper presents upper limits on dark photon/baryon coupling (U(1)_B) from LIGO-Virgo O3 data (2019-2020). Two independent analysis methods used: cross-correlation and BSD (Band Sampled Data). Best constraints reported as squared coupling ε² at specific masses. Cross-correlation method gives ε² ≈ 2.65×10⁻⁴⁶ at m_A ≈ 4.31×10⁻¹³ eV; BSD method gives ε² ≈ 2.4×10⁻⁴⁷ at m_A ≈ 5.7×10⁻¹³ eV. BSD limits are more stringent overall due to optimized coherence time and full sensitivity to finite light-travel-time effect. Mass range: 10⁻¹⁴ to 10⁻¹¹ eV (10–2000 Hz). Improves O1 limits by ~100× in mass range 2–4×10⁻¹³ eV. DM density of 0.3 GeV/cm³ is standard galactic halo assumption used in dark photon coupling calculations (equation 5). No evidence of signal found; limits are 95% CL using Feldman-Cousins approach.
